Name: Whip
Author: hkccc
Description: After speaking with Shane or Demetrius, players can purchase it from Pierre or Joja Mart. This tool can be used to attack NPCs you dislike. You can customize which NPCs it attacks and whether it causes affinity loss. It can be upgraded once at the blacksmith for 5 Tear Crystals and 20,000 coins. After upgrading, NPCs will react more intensely when attacked.

Manifest.Name: Whip
Manifest.Description: Adds a whip to the game that can be used on certain NPCs.
